Uses sitemap URLs exclusively without following page links

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"respect_robots_txt\":false}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.map_urls_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(length(result.urls))
```
